notes: Dashboard shows a task's real state (a failed fix is no longer “Finished”), task runs no longer count as failing checks, and tapping a task started on GitHub opens it in a chat with its reports. Long chat replies no longer time out mid-answer. The agent fixes PRs more reliably: it is shown the real text to edit, asks for strict JSON and logs why a model was skipped. Its self-check is honest: open problems lead with “Not finished”, every ask in a task is checked separately, and deleting unrelated code (like Enter-to-send) is caught.
